evidence: Mobilithek/BNetzA-derived station evidence ties DE*LSG EVSEs to Ladestationen Südwest GmbH & Co. KG.

Stadtwerke Zweibruecken publishes exact current ad-hoc tariffs for Ladestationen Suedwest stations in Zweibruecken: AC 0.56 EUR/kWh, DC 0.69 EUR/kWh, 0.50 EUR transaction fee, blocking AC after 300 min at 0.04 EUR/min, DC after 120 min at 0.08 EUR/min, max 12 EUR, with listed parking-garage exemptions and no AC blocking charge 21:00-06:00.
entries.decision: No network-wide fallback. Exact direct price is demonstrably site/municipality dependent; resolve per EVSE/site.

Current station-level observations repeatedly show AC 0.66 EUR/kWh plus 0.03 EUR/min after 240 min and DC/HPC 0.89 EUR/kWh at several HomE locations.
entries.decision: Keep fail-closed until a primary-source tariff contract or exhaustive EVSE-level checkout confirms applicability across the canonical DEHOM set.

evidence: Official Autostrom plus tariff update states that from 2026-01-01 all ad-hoc charging at its charging parks/stations costs 0.69 EUR/kWh and the previous blocking fee is removed.
Official current tariff page states uniform site-independent direct-payment/QR pricing and no blocking fee; multiple DE*AUP EVSE checkout pages identify Autostrom plus and show 0.69 EUR/kWh.
entries.decision: Tariff authority is strongly established, but retain partial until canonical audit confirms every DEAUP EVSE belongs to Autostrom plus and no delegated/partner exceptions exist.

evidence: Multiple DE*WEA EVSEs from current public/BNetzA-derived station data are tied to Westenergie Metering GmbH.
Current station-level direct-payment evidence repeatedly shows 0.67 EUR/kWh across several AC sites, with at least one 50 kW site also at 0.67 EUR/kWh.
entries.decision: Do not promote a network fallback without a current primary Westenergie tariff source or exhaustive EVSE-level evidence.
